requires_external_validation.scope: Acquire both quadratures in interleaved order-swap, randomized-phase, single-pulse, off-resonant, common-branch and atomic-background controls, with recorded molecular identity/reset and every erasure. Measure a full cycle's propagation/Stark/phase/contrast channel, trial rate and uniform loss/systematic budget under one consistent dipole/bath model. Only then test a specified anharmonic target against the strongest equally informed spectroscopy method at complete cost. No thermodynamic or kinetic mean certificate transfers without its separate observability/full-support assumptions.
